scholarships.title: TWAS-CSIR Postgraduate Fellowship Programme
scholarships.official_source: UNESCO-TWAS and Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), India

existing.description: TWAS-CSIR Postgraduate Fellowships are tenable in CSIR research laboratories and institutes in India for a maximum period of four years.
eligibility: Maximum age of 35 years on 31 December of the application year
National of a developing country, other than India
Must not hold any visa for temporary or permanent residency in India or any developed country
Must hold a Master's degree in science and technology
Must be regularly employed in their home country and hold a research assignment there
Sandwich fellowships: must be a registered PhD student in the home country and provide the Registration and No Objection Certificate from the home university
Full-time fellowships: must be willing to register at a university in India within the first year if agreed by CSIR
Must be accepted at a CSIR laboratory or institution and provide an official acceptance letter from the host institution
Must provide evidence of English proficiency if the medium of education was not English
Must provide evidence that they will return to their home country on completion of the fellowship
Must not take up other assignments during the fellowship period
Must be financially responsible for any accompanying family members
existing.eligibility_summary: Nationals of a developing country other than India, aged 35 or under on 31 December of the application year, holding a Master's degree in science and technology, regularly employed with a research assignment in their home country, accepted at a CSIR laboratory or institution with an official acceptance letter, and not holding a visa for temporary or permanent residency in India or any developed country.
benefits: Monthly stipend covering living costs, food and health insurance
Placement in a CSIR laboratory or institute with research facilities
Up to 4 years of funding for full-time applicants
coverage: Monthly stipend from CSIR to cover living costs, food and health insurance
Full-time fellowship tenable for up to 4 years in a CSIR laboratory or institute
requirements: Applications may only be submitted to TWAS through the online portal
Applicants may apply for only one programme per calendar year in the TWAS and OWSD portfolio
Applicants are encouraged to request the preliminary acceptance letter as early as possible, even before the call opening date
Only acceptance letters dated the same year as the application year are eligible
The chosen host must be one of the eligible CSIR laboratories and institutes
documents: Official acceptance letter from the chosen CSIR host institution
Registration and No Objection Certificate signed by the Vice-Chancellor or Registrar of the home university, for sandwich applicants, sent to both CSIR and TWAS
Evidence of English proficiency if the medium of education was not English
Evidence of intent to return to the home country on completion of the fellowship
existing.english_requirement: The official page states "The language of instruction for foreign scholars in CSIR laboratories/institutes is English." Applicants whose medium of education was not English must provide evidence of English proficiency.
application_method: Register on the TWAS online application portal at https://onlineforms.twas.org/apply/300 once the call is open
Complete the online form and upload the supporting documents listed in the call
Send a copy of the home university Registration and No Objection Certificate to both CSIR and TWAS for sandwich applicants
existing.selection_notes: Results of the fellowship selection are expected at the end of 2026 or early 2027 and selected candidates will be able to start their fellowship no earlier than 2027. Requests for acceptance must be directed to the chosen CSIR host institutions, and without preliminary acceptance the application will not be considered for selection.
existing.best_fit: Master's-level scientists and engineers from developing countries, aged 35 or under, who want to complete a PhD research placement in a CSIR laboratory or institute in India.
existing.notes: The monthly stipend is not convertible into foreign currency. The fellowship requires the researcher to return to their home country on completion, so it is a temporary research placement rather than permanent migration.
existing.duration: Full-time fellowships up to a maximum of 4 years; sandwich fellowships from a minimum of 6 months up to a maximum decided by the host institute but no greater than 3 years
existing.application_period: Annual. The 2026 call opened 6 March 2026 and closed 20 May 2026, extended to 3 June 2026. Applications can only be submitted through the TWAS online portal once the call is open.
existing.deadline_display: Official wording for the 2026 call: "Closing date of this fellowship: 6 then 20 May 2026 now extended until 3 June 2026". The call is closed and results are expected at the end of 2026 or early 2027, with fellows starting no earlier than 2027.
existing.program_type: Doctoral research fellowship tenable in CSIR laboratories and institutes in India
